name: Anna A. Higgins
bioAdditions: The Pennsylvania death-certificate index for 1951 lists "Anna Meier", Wilkes-Barre, Luzerne County (county 40), died 10-06-51, certificate file 86969 (S1). This independently confirms the FamilySearch death date and gives the number needed to order her certificate, which should name her parents. A search of the 1890 Schuylkill County census directory (S2) found no Higgins household in New Philadelphia borough, so the family had probably left the town before 1890; Higgins households were listed elsewhere in the county (Norwegian Twp, Mahanoy, Pottsville etc.), none of them a William with wife Mary Ann.

openQuestionsResolved.question: Her 1951 PA death certificate (Ancestry PA Death Certificates 1906–1970) should name her parents and their birthplaces.
openQuestionsResolved.answer: Not yet seen, but the certificate is now identified: PA 1951 death file no. 86969 (Wilkes-Barre, 6 Oct 1951). Order from PA State Archives or view on Ancestry.
